meta.title: Ashes and Temples
meta.description: Your suffering ends here. Use the key that you hold to open the door to peace.

units.rawText: Over a dozen patrolling troops surround me, their eyes filled with hostility as they point their guns at me.
units.displayText: Over a dozen patrolling troops surround me, their eyes filled with hostility as they point their guns at me.

spans.text: Over a dozen patrolling troops surround me, their eyes filled with hostility as they point their guns at me.

units.rawText: You sure caused us a lot of problems... Let me guess, your friends did the armory in too? Damn, you're good at this.
units.displayText: You sure caused us a lot of problems... Let me guess, your friends did the armory in too? Damn, you're good at this.

spans.text: You sure caused us a lot of problems... Let me guess, your friends did the armory in too? Damn, you're good at this.

units.rawText: He puts more weight into his foot with every word he says.
units.displayText: He puts more weight into his foot with every word he says.

spans.text: He puts more weight into his foot with every word he says.

units.rawText: When I saw someone on the camp's cameras earlier, I thought it might be you, but I didn't think you'd do something this ballsy a second time.
units.displayText: When I saw someone on the camp's cameras earlier, I thought it might be you, but I didn't think you'd do something this ballsy a second time.

spans.text: When I saw someone on the camp's cameras earlier, I thought it might be you, but I didn't think you'd do something this ballsy a second time.

units.rawText: And yet, you came here to serve yourself up to me... Looks like it's curtains for you.
units.displayText: And yet, you came here to serve yourself up to me... Looks like it's curtains for you.

spans.text: And yet, you came here to serve yourself up to me... Looks like it's curtains for you.

units.rawText: The capture squad captain kicks my rifle away, and then his gaze falls on the knife at my waist, which makes him laugh.
units.displayText: The capture squad captain kicks my rifle away, and then his gaze falls on the knife at my waist, which makes him laugh.

spans.text: The capture squad captain kicks my rifle away, and then his gaze falls on the knife at my waist, which makes him laugh.

units.rawText: He takes it out and casually tosses it to the ground beside me.
units.displayText: He takes it out and casually tosses it to the ground beside me.

spans.text: He takes it out and casually tosses it to the ground beside me.

units.rawText: What's this? Carrying a knife on you? Did you actually expect it to save your life?
units.displayText: What's this? Carrying a knife on you? Did you actually expect it to save your life?

spans.text: What's this? Carrying a knife on you? Did you actually expect it to save your life?

units.rawText: ...Yup. I promised its owner I'd fight to the bitter end, so how can I just give up like this?
units.displayText: ...Yup. I promised its owner I'd fight to the bitter end, so how can I just give up like this?

spans.text: ...Yup. I promised its owner I'd fight to the bitter end, so how can I just give up like this?

units.rawText: Centaureissi! You're up!
units.displayText: Centaureissi! You're up!

spans.text: Centaureissi! You're up!

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: A bullet through the calf wipes the cockiness off the capture squad captain's face. I take the opportunity to struggle free before grabbing my rifle and ducking behind cover.
units.displayText: A bullet through the calf wipes the cockiness off the capture squad captain's face. I take the opportunity to struggle free before grabbing my rifle and ducking behind cover.

spans.text: A bullet through the calf wipes the cockiness off the capture squad captain's face. I take the opportunity to struggle free before grabbing my rifle and ducking behind cover.

units.rawText: As I'm doing this, a blur of yellow descends from the wall and tosses the knives she's holding toward the soldiers surrounding me.
units.displayText: As I'm doing this, a blur of yellow descends from the wall and tosses the knives she's holding toward the soldiers surrounding me.

spans.text: As I'm doing this, a blur of yellow descends from the wall and tosses the knives she's holding toward the soldiers surrounding me.

units.rawText: Guh!
units.displayText: Guh!

spans.text: Guh!

units.rawText: Centaureissi does not linger over their death cries, instead taking out the G36 from her carrying case and laying down suppressive fire before rushing over to me.
units.displayText: Centaureissi does not linger over their death cries, instead taking out the G36 from her carrying case and laying down suppressive fire before rushing over to me.

spans.text: Centaureissi does not linger over their death cries, instead taking out the G36 from her carrying case and laying down suppressive fire before rushing over to me.

units.rawText: Commander! Are you alright?
units.displayText: Commander! Are you alright?

spans.text: Commander! Are you alright?

units.rawText: I'm fine.
units.displayText: I'm fine.

spans.text: I'm fine.

units.rawText: Bang-bang-bang!
units.displayText: Bang-bang-bang!

spans.text: Bang-bang-bang!

units.rawText: The sentries in the distance sense something is off and immediately begin spraying us with bullets. Their barrage is so intense neither Centaureissi nor I can even stick our heads out to shoot back.
units.displayText: The sentries in the distance sense something is off and immediately begin spraying us with bullets. Their barrage is so intense neither Centaureissi nor I can even stick our heads out to shoot back.

spans.text: The sentries in the distance sense something is off and immediately begin spraying us with bullets. Their barrage is so intense neither Centaureissi nor I can even stick our heads out to shoot back.

units.rawText: (Hisses) Dammit... Dammit! Die, all of you, die!
units.displayText: (Hisses) Dammit... Dammit! Die, all of you, die!

spans.text: (Hisses) Dammit... Dammit! Die, all of you, die!

units.rawText: Fire! Open fire!
units.displayText: Fire! Open fire!

spans.text: Fire! Open fire!

units.rawText: The capture squad captain grabs his leg where he was shot and yells at his troops to attack.
units.displayText: The capture squad captain grabs his leg where he was shot and yells at his troops to attack.

spans.text: The capture squad captain grabs his leg where he was shot and yells at his troops to attack.

units.rawText: Perhaps they're worried about the other facilities within the base, but the enemy soldiers do not use grenades; instead, they try to overwhelm us with gunfire.
units.displayText: Perhaps they're worried about the other facilities within the base, but the enemy soldiers do not use grenades; instead, they try to overwhelm us with gunfire.

spans.text: Perhaps they're worried about the other facilities within the base, but the enemy soldiers do not use grenades; instead, they try to overwhelm us with gunfire.

units.rawText: The formerly sturdy wall we're hiding behind is shot to bits by the countless guns firing on it; it would seem it's about to stop serving as cover anytime soon.
units.displayText: The formerly sturdy wall we're hiding behind is shot to bits by the countless guns firing on it; it would seem it's about to stop serving as cover anytime soon.

spans.text: The formerly sturdy wall we're hiding behind is shot to bits by the countless guns firing on it; it would seem it's about to stop serving as cover anytime soon.

units.rawText: Centaureissi seems to have made up her mind about something and presses her sole remaining grenade into my hand.
units.displayText: Centaureissi seems to have made up her mind about something and presses her sole remaining grenade into my hand.

spans.text: Centaureissi seems to have made up her mind about something and presses her sole remaining grenade into my hand.

units.rawText: Commander, I'll draw the enemy's attention; look for an opportunity to throw the grenade so you can run!
units.displayText: Commander, I'll draw the enemy's attention; look for an opportunity to throw the grenade so you can run!

spans.text: Commander, I'll draw the enemy's attention; look for an opportunity to throw the grenade so you can run!

units.rawText: You mean... you want me to use you as bait?
units.displayText: You mean... you want me to use you as bait?

spans.text: You mean... you want me to use you as bait?

units.rawText: Yes. This appears to be the only option available to us.
units.displayText: Yes. This appears to be the only option available to us.

spans.text: Yes. This appears to be the only option available to us.

units.rawText: It was an honor to fight by your side, Commander.
units.displayText: It was an honor to fight by your side, Commander.

spans.text: It was an honor to fight by your side, Commander.

units.rawText: She delivers that pretty line in a calm tone. There is no sign of fear on her.
units.displayText: She delivers that pretty line in a calm tone. There is no sign of fear on her.

spans.text: She delivers that pretty line in a calm tone. There is no sign of fear on her.

units.rawText: I remember the days I spent with this girl, and laugh.
units.displayText: I remember the days I spent with this girl, and laugh.

spans.text: I remember the days I spent with this girl, and laugh.

units.rawText: ...Commander?
units.displayText: ...Commander?

spans.text: ...Commander?

units.rawText: Relax... I didn't just destroy their communications center.
units.displayText: Relax... I didn't just destroy their communications center.

spans.text: Relax... I didn't just destroy their communications center.

units.rawText: What in the ever-living hell are you worthless shitstains doing? Why are those two scampering rats not dead yet!
units.displayText: What in the ever-living hell are you worthless shitstains doing? Why are those two scampering rats not dead yet!

spans.text: What in the ever-living hell are you worthless shitstains doing? Why are those two scampering rats not dead yet!

units.rawText: Charge! Shoot! Sh...
units.displayText: Charge! Shoot! Sh...

spans.text: Charge! Shoot! Sh...

units.rawText: <size=40>Bang-bang!</size>
units.displayText: Bang-bang!

spans.text: Bang-bang!

units.rawText: Gunfire from a third party fills the night air and rips through the enemy soldiers' back line.
units.displayText: Gunfire from a third party fills the night air and rips through the enemy soldiers' back line.

spans.text: Gunfire from a third party fills the night air and rips through the enemy soldiers' back line.

units.rawText: Shit! This is bad!
units.displayText: Shit! This is bad!

spans.text: Shit! This is bad!

units.rawText: Looks like they made it.
units.displayText: Looks like they made it.

spans.text: Looks like they made it.

units.rawText: Could it be... our reinforcements? Commander, what did you do to have them arrive so quickly?
units.displayText: Could it be... our reinforcements? Commander, what did you do to have them arrive so quickly?

spans.text: Could it be... our reinforcements? Commander, what did you do to have them arrive so quickly?

units.rawText: ...I had my doubts about what happened with Tony. I was wondering why they managed to pinpoint and attack the communicator so quickly.
units.displayText: ...I had my doubts about what happened with Tony. I was wondering why they managed to pinpoint and attack the communicator so quickly.

spans.text: ...I had my doubts about what happened with Tony. I was wondering why they managed to pinpoint and attack the communicator so quickly.

units.rawText: After I snuck into the comms center, I did some snooping around and managed to crack the encryption on their equipment, which allowed me to contact our little carrier pigeon...
units.displayText: After I snuck into the comms center, I did some snooping around and managed to crack the encryption on their equipment, which allowed me to contact our little carrier pigeon...

spans.text: After I snuck into the comms center, I did some snooping around and managed to crack the encryption on their equipment, which allowed me to contact our little carrier pigeon...

units.rawText: Just then, a youthful voice reaches us from afar.
units.displayText: Just then, a youthful voice reaches us from afar.

spans.text: Just then, a youthful voice reaches us from afar.

units.rawText: Commander! Big Sis Centaureissi! I'm here to save you! Just hang in there a little longer!
units.displayText: Commander! Big Sis Centaureissi! I'm here to save you! Just hang in there a little longer!

spans.text: Commander! Big Sis Centaureissi! I'm here to save you! Just hang in there a little longer!

units.rawText: As our reinforcements arrive, the originally dire situation quickly turns around. Pinned down by mortar bombardments and gunfire, many enemy soldiers choose to lay down their arms and surrender.
units.displayText: As our reinforcements arrive, the originally dire situation quickly turns around. Pinned down by mortar bombardments and gunfire, many enemy soldiers choose to lay down their arms and surrender.

spans.text: As our reinforcements arrive, the originally dire situation quickly turns around. Pinned down by mortar bombardments and gunfire, many enemy soldiers choose to lay down their arms and surrender.

units.rawText: Gradually, the shooting stops, announcing our victory.
units.displayText: Gradually, the shooting stops, announcing our victory.

spans.text: Gradually, the shooting stops, announcing our victory.

units.rawText: Chris runs up to us and tackle-hugs the two of us.
units.displayText: Chris runs up to us and tackle-hugs the two of us.

spans.text: Chris runs up to us and tackle-hugs the two of us.

units.rawText: (Sob) Commander! Big Sis Centaureissi! I'm so glad the two of you are okay!
units.displayText: (Sob) Commander! Big Sis Centaureissi! I'm so glad the two of you are okay!

spans.text: (Sob) Commander! Big Sis Centaureissi! I'm so glad the two of you are okay!

units.rawText: Sorry to make you worry.
units.displayText: Sorry to make you worry.

spans.text: Sorry to make you worry.

units.rawText: Looks like you carried out the mission I gave you...
units.displayText: Looks like you carried out the mission I gave you...

spans.text: Looks like you carried out the mission I gave you...

units.rawText: Hehe~ I'm a reliable carrier pigeon now, Commander!
units.displayText: Hehe~ I'm a reliable carrier pigeon now, Commander!

spans.text: Hehe~ I'm a reliable carrier pigeon now, Commander!

units.rawText: Oh yeah, I picked this up just now! This should be yours, right, Big Sis Centaureissi?
units.displayText: Oh yeah, I picked this up just now! This should be yours, right, Big Sis Centaureissi?

spans.text: Oh yeah, I picked this up just now! This should be yours, right, Big Sis Centaureissi?

units.rawText: Chris shows us the knife she's holding. It would seem she picked it up on the way here.
units.displayText: Chris shows us the knife she's holding. It would seem she picked it up on the way here.

spans.text: Chris shows us the knife she's holding. It would seem she picked it up on the way here.

units.rawText: She is about to place it back in Centaureissi's hand when she is interrupted by a shout.
units.displayText: She is about to place it back in Centaureissi's hand when she is interrupted by a shout.

spans.text: She is about to place it back in Centaureissi's hand when she is interrupted by a shout.

units.rawText: <size=40>What the hell are you all playing at?!</size>
units.displayText: What the hell are you all playing at?!

spans.text: What the hell are you all playing at?!

units.rawText: I instinctively pull Chris behind me. It would seem there is still one last fish trying desperately to break the net.
units.displayText: I instinctively pull Chris behind me. It would seem there is still one last fish trying desperately to break the net.

spans.text: I instinctively pull Chris behind me. It would seem there is still one last fish trying desperately to break the net.

units.rawText: Y-You worthless lot! You're all trash!
units.displayText: Y-You worthless lot! You're all trash!

spans.text: Y-You worthless lot! You're all trash!

units.rawText: I do not give you permission to surrender! Keep fighting! Shoot!
units.displayText: I do not give you permission to surrender! Keep fighting! Shoot!

spans.text: I do not give you permission to surrender! Keep fighting! Shoot!

units.rawText: He is so deep in his demented rage that he does not notice his magazine is empty, still yelling as he pulls the trigger on an empty chamber over and over again.
units.displayText: He is so deep in his demented rage that he does not notice his magazine is empty, still yelling as he pulls the trigger on an empty chamber over and over again.

spans.text: He is so deep in his demented rage that he does not notice his magazine is empty, still yelling as he pulls the trigger on an empty chamber over and over again.

units.rawText: Throw down your weapon and surrender. There's no need for any more casualties.
units.displayText: Throw down your weapon and surrender. There's no need for any more casualties.

spans.text: Throw down your weapon and surrender. There's no need for any more casualties.

units.rawText: <size=40>No! This isn't over! Not by a longshot!</size>
units.displayText: No! This isn't over! Not by a longshot!

spans.text: No! This isn't over! Not by a longshot!

units.rawText: He feels at his belt for a grenade, but there is nothing there.
units.displayText: He feels at his belt for a grenade, but there is nothing there.

spans.text: He feels at his belt for a grenade, but there is nothing there.

units.rawText: In despair, the capture squad captain sees Chris, who's holding a knife.
units.displayText: In despair, the capture squad captain sees Chris, who's holding a knife.

spans.text: In despair, the capture squad captain sees Chris, who's holding a knife.

units.rawText: You brat, I remember you! You're that bastard Izka's kid!
units.displayText: You brat, I remember you! You're that bastard Izka's kid!

spans.text: You brat, I remember you! You're that bastard Izka's kid!

units.rawText: That's right, I gave the order to kill your dad! Ahahaha!
units.displayText: That's right, I gave the order to kill your dad! Ahahaha!

spans.text: That's right, I gave the order to kill your dad! Ahahaha!

units.rawText: Grk!
units.displayText: Grk!

spans.text: Grk!

units.rawText: Upon hearing this, Chris' hands tremble.
units.displayText: Upon hearing this, Chris' hands tremble.

spans.text: Upon hearing this, Chris' hands tremble.

units.rawText: The capture squad captain seems to be enjoying this. He makes excessively provocative gestures, as though trying to aggravate Chris further.
units.displayText: The capture squad captain seems to be enjoying this. He makes excessively provocative gestures, as though trying to aggravate Chris further.

spans.text: The capture squad captain seems to be enjoying this. He makes excessively provocative gestures, as though trying to aggravate Chris further.

units.rawText: Now you've got the chance to take revenge for your dad! Come on, do it!
units.displayText: Now you've got the chance to take revenge for your dad! Come on, do it!

spans.text: Now you've got the chance to take revenge for your dad! Come on, do it!

units.rawText: <color=orange>I'm not falling for it.</color>
units.displayText: I'm not falling for it.

spans.text: I'm not falling for it.

units.rawText: Chris shakes her head and hands the knife back to Centaureissi.
units.displayText: Chris shakes her head and hands the knife back to Centaureissi.

spans.text: Chris shakes her head and hands the knife back to Centaureissi.

units.rawText: You were planning to take me hostage when I went after you, right?
units.displayText: You were planning to take me hostage when I went after you, right?

spans.text: You were planning to take me hostage when I went after you, right?

units.rawText: I do hate you, but I will never allow my emotions to get the better of me again.
units.displayText: I do hate you, but I will never allow my emotions to get the better of me again.

spans.text: I do hate you, but I will never allow my emotions to get the better of me again.

units.rawText: My little pigeon flaps her wings and makes her choice.
units.displayText: My little pigeon flaps her wings and makes her choice.

spans.text: My little pigeon flaps her wings and makes her choice.

units.rawText: Chris...
units.displayText: Chris...

spans.text: Chris...

units.rawText: She's right. There's no point in fighting on like this.
units.displayText: She's right. There's no point in fighting on like this.

spans.text: She's right. There's no point in fighting on like this.

units.rawText: Surrender... Our reinforcements have you completely surrounded.
units.displayText: Surrender... Our reinforcements have you completely surrounded.

spans.text: Surrender... Our reinforcements have you completely surrounded.

units.rawText: ...Damn, you're lame.
units.displayText: ...Damn, you're lame.

spans.text: ...Damn, you're lame.

units.rawText: The capture squad captain gets on his knees and raises his hands to us in surrender.
units.displayText: The capture squad captain gets on his knees and raises his hands to us in surrender.

spans.text: The capture squad captain gets on his knees and raises his hands to us in surrender.

units.rawText: Commander, thank you for taking the huge risk of infiltrating the enemy camp and destroying their armory.
units.displayText: Commander, thank you for taking the huge risk of infiltrating the enemy camp and destroying their armory.

spans.text: Commander, thank you for taking the huge risk of infiltrating the enemy camp and destroying their armory.

units.rawText: The reinforcement troops are helping the defenders clear out the enemies still hiding inside the city. Your mission is complete.
units.displayText: The reinforcement troops are helping the defenders clear out the enemies still hiding inside the city. Your mission is complete.

spans.text: The reinforcement troops are helping the defenders clear out the enemies still hiding inside the city. Your mission is complete.

units.rawText: Is it now... That's good... Hng...
units.displayText: Is it now... That's good... Hng...

spans.text: Is it now... That's good... Hng...

units.rawText: The wounds and fatigue I've suffered finally catch up with me and I stumble. The moment she sees me wobble, Centaureissi is by my side and holding me up.
units.displayText: The wounds and fatigue I've suffered finally catch up with me and I stumble. The moment she sees me wobble, Centaureissi is by my side and holding me up.

spans.text: The wounds and fatigue I've suffered finally catch up with me and I stumble. The moment she sees me wobble, Centaureissi is by my side and holding me up.

units.rawText: Commander, are you alright?
units.displayText: Commander, are you alright?

spans.text: Commander, are you alright?

units.rawText: I'm fine... it's okay.
units.displayText: I'm fine... it's okay.

spans.text: I'm fine... it's okay.

units.rawText: I'll take the Commander back for treatment. We'll be leaving this place to you.
units.displayText: I'll take the Commander back for treatment. We'll be leaving this place to you.

spans.text: I'll take the Commander back for treatment. We'll be leaving this place to you.

units.rawText: Yes, ma'am! Understood!
units.displayText: Yes, ma'am! Understood!

spans.text: Yes, ma'am! Understood!

units.rawText: Take care. There's still heavy fighting inside the city, but according to reports from the field, the fighting's almost over.
units.displayText: Take care. There's still heavy fighting inside the city, but according to reports from the field, the fighting's almost over.

spans.text: Take care. There's still heavy fighting inside the city, but according to reports from the field, the fighting's almost over.

units.rawText: After speaking those words, the man crisply salutes and leaves.
units.displayText: After speaking those words, the man crisply salutes and leaves.

spans.text: After speaking those words, the man crisply salutes and leaves.

units.rawText: Centaureissi helps me out of this hellhole and we head for a nearby watchtower where we can look at the city in the distance.
units.displayText: Centaureissi helps me out of this hellhole and we head for a nearby watchtower where we can look at the city in the distance.

spans.text: Centaureissi helps me out of this hellhole and we head for a nearby watchtower where we can look at the city in the distance.

units.rawText: This is the last hardship this city will have to go through...
units.displayText: This is the last hardship this city will have to go through...

spans.text: This is the last hardship this city will have to go through...

units.rawText: Yeah, I'm sure its suffering will be over soon... After all, some things can't be destroyed by war.
units.displayText: Yeah, I'm sure its suffering will be over soon... After all, some things can't be destroyed by war.

spans.text: Yeah, I'm sure its suffering will be over soon... After all, some things can't be destroyed by war.

units.rawText: A distant clocktower strikes the time as the sunlight once again illuminates this war-torn land.
units.displayText: A distant clocktower strikes the time as the sunlight once again illuminates this war-torn land.

spans.text: A distant clocktower strikes the time as the sunlight once again illuminates this war-torn land.

units.rawText: And in a corner where nobody can see, a little daisy triumphs over the harsh cold and blossoms, awaiting the rebirth of all things.
units.displayText: And in a corner where nobody can see, a little daisy triumphs over the harsh cold and blossoms, awaiting the rebirth of all things.

spans.text: And in a corner where nobody can see, a little daisy triumphs over the harsh cold and blossoms, awaiting the rebirth of all things.

units.rawText: Dad once told me that "hatred only begets more hatred". So I'm going to let that cycle end here and now.
units.displayText: Dad once told me that "hatred only begets more hatred". So I'm going to let that cycle end here and now.

spans.text: Dad once told me that "hatred only begets more hatred". So I'm going to let that cycle end here and now.

units.rawText: But you'll get what you deserve.
units.displayText: But you'll get what you deserve.

spans.text: But you'll get what you deserve.
